# 1. Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(crayon)
library(merTools)
library(boot)
library(splines)
library(stringr)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)
```
# 2. Vowels sapce Area

# 2.1. Formant
```{r}
df_no_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_no_ADS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))

# occurance column
df_no_ADS <- df_no_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())             

df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_no_IDS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_no_IDS <- df_no_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number()) 

df_da_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_da_ADS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_ADS <- df_da_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())

df_da_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_da_IDS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_IDS <- df_da_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())   

# Calculate summary statistics for each session_id
#session_stats <- df_no_ADS %>%
  #group_by(session_id) %>%
  #summarise(
    #mean_value = mean(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,  # mean 
    #sd_value = sd(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,       # Standard deviation
    #max_value = max(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,     # Maximum value
    #min_value = min(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,     # Minimum value
    #num_observations = n(),                              # Number of observations
    #num_unique_spk_id = n_distinct(spkid)                # Number of unique speaker IDs
  #)

# View the result
#print(session_stats)


output.2.1 <- lmer.full.reduced.null.compare(ConvexHullArea ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth + (1+Register|spkid) , 
                        optimizer = "nloptwrap", 
                         maxfun = 100000,
                        fullm = TRUE,
                         redm = FALSE, 
                         redmformula = NULL, #ConvexHullArea ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1|spkid), 
                         nullm = FALSE, 
                         nullmformula = ConvexHullArea ~  AgeMonth + (1+Register|spkid) ,
                        data_list = list(df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS, df_da_ADS, df_da_IDS),
                        marginal_means = TRUE,
                        specs = ~Register*Language
                        )

# Define custom contrasts based interaction levels
custom_contrasts <- list(
  "ADS*no vs IDS*no" = c(0, 0, 1, -1),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'IDS no'
  "ADS*da vs IDS*da" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS da' vs 'IDS da'
  "ADS*no vs ADS*da" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'ADS da'
  "IDS*no vs IDS*da" = c(0, -1, 0, 1)     # Comparing 'IDS no' vs 'IDS da'
)
contrast_results.2.1 <- compute_contrasts(output.2.1$emmeans, compute_pairwise = FALSE, custom_contrasts = custom_contrasts, adjust_method = "sidak")
```


```{r}
# Prepare the plot data (aggregating the actual data)
plot.data <- output.2.1$fit_data %>%
  group_by(Language, Register, spkid) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(ConvexHullArea), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
# Extract numeric part of spk_id
plot.data[plot.data$Language == 'no', ]$spkid <- str_extract(plot.data[plot.data$Language == 'no', ]$spkid, "[0-9]+")

three_vowels_formant_vowel_space_area <- lmer.plot.emmeans.contrasts(emmeans.data = output.2.1$emmeans, 
                       contrasts.data = contrast_results.2.1$contrasts, 
                       raw_data = plot.data, 
                       y.ax.transformation = TRUE,
                       inv_y_transform_fun = function(x) { exp(x) - 1 }, 
                       div = 1000000,
                       x_labs = 'Groups (Register*Language)',
                       y_labs = "Vowel Space Area (kHz^2)",
                       y_lim = c(0, 0.6),
                      scale_size_range = c(1, 5),
                      color_gradient_low = "grey60",   
                      color_gradient_high = "grey10",  
                      color_breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),             
                      size_breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),              
                      y_breaks = seq(0,0.4, by = 0.1),
                      size_scaling = NULL,
                      aspect_ratio = NULL,
                      title = NULL,
                      legend = FALSE )

```

# 4. Separability
#4.1. Formant
```{r}
df_no_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Separability", "formant_no_ADS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))

# occurance column
df_no_ADS <- df_no_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())             

df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Separability", "formant_no_IDS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_no_IDS <- df_no_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number()) 

df_da_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Separability", "formant_da_ADS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_ADS <- df_da_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())

df_da_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Separability", "formant_da_IDS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_IDS <- df_da_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())   


output.4.1 <- glmmTB.full.reduced.null.compare(fullmformula = separability ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth  + (1+Register|spkid),
                                           family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
                                           zi_formula = ~0,
                                             fullm = TRUE,
                                             redm = FALSE, 
                                             redmformula = separability ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth + session_id + (1|spkid), 
                                             nullm = FALSE, 
                                             nullmformula = NULL,
                                             data_list = list(df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS, df_da_ADS, df_da_IDS), 
                                           marginal_means = TRUE,
                                          specs = ~Register*Language
                                          )

# Define custom contrasts based interaction levels
custom_contrasts <- list(
  "ADS*no vs IDS*no" = c(0, 0, 1, -1),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'IDS no'
  "ADS*da vs IDS*da" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS da' vs 'IDS da'
  "ADS*no vs ADS*da" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'ADS da'
  "IDS*no vs IDS*da" = c(0, -1, 0, 1)     # Comparing 'IDS no' vs 'IDS da'
)
contrast_results.4.1 <- compute_contrasts(output.4.1$emmeans, compute_pairwise = FALSE, custom_contrasts = custom_contrasts, adjust_method = "sidak")
```

```{r}
# Prepare the plot data (aggregating the actual data)
plot.data <- output.4.1$fit_data %>%
  group_by(Language, Register, spkid) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(separability), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
# Extract numeric part of spk_id
plot.data[plot.data$Language == 'no', ]$spkid <- str_extract(plot.data[plot.data$Language == 'no', ]$spkid, "[0-9]+")

three_vowels_formant_separability <- glmmTB.plot.emmeans.contrasts(emmeans.data = output.4.1$emmeans, 
                       contrasts.data = contrast_results.4.1$contrasts, 
                       raw_data = plot.data, 
                       x_labs = 'Groups (Register*Language)',
                       y_labs = "Separability (pillai score)",
                       y_lim = c(0, 1.5),
                      scale_size_range = c(1, 5),
                      color_gradient_low = "grey60",   
                      color_gradient_high = "grey10",  
                      color_breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),             
                      size_breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),              
                      y_breaks = seq(0,1, by = 0.2),
                      size_scaling = NULL,
                      aspect_ratio = NULL,
                      title = NULL,
                      legend = FALSE )

```

## Beta regression model for F1 scores

```{r}
library(betareg)
library(MASS)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(betareg)


# Standardize predictors
#data$z_Area <- scale(data$ConvexHullArea)
#data$z_Variability <- scale(data$variability)

# Adjust F1 Score if it contains 0 or 1
#data$Adjusted_F1 <- (data$F1_Score * (nrow(data) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(data)

```

```{r}
data = read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "CombinedMeasures", "formant_XGBoost_3_corner_vowels.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
# Fit beta, norm, gamma distribution
fitbeta <- fitdist(data$F1_Score, "beta", method = "mle")
fitnorm <- fitdist(data$F1_Score, "norm", method = "mle")
fitgamma <- fitdist(data$F1_Score, "gamma", method = "mle")

# Summary of fit
summary(fitbeta)
summary(fitnorm)
summary(fitgamma)

# Plot fitted distribution
#plot(fit)


```

```{r}
# Fit Beta Regression Model
# Load the package


# Standardize predictors
data$z_Area <- scale(data$ConvexHullArea)
data$z_Variability <- scale(data$variability)

# Add Polynomial Terms
data$z_Area2 <- data$z_Area^2
data$z_Variability2 <- data$z_Variability^2

# Adjust F1 Score if it contains 0 or 1
data$Adjusted_F1 <- (data$F1_Score * (nrow(data) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(data)

# Fit Beta Regression Model with Polynomial Terms
model <- betareg(
  Adjusted_F1 ~ z_Area + z_Variability + z_Area:z_Variability + z_Area2 + 
    z_Variability2,
  data = data
)

# Model Summary
summary(model)



```

```{r}
# Define constants and functions for inverse z-transformation
mean_area <- mean(data$ConvexHullArea)  # Replace 'Area' with the original area column name
sd_area <- sd(data$ConvexHullArea)

# Define a sequence for z_Area (varying z-transformed area)
z_area_seq <- seq(min(data$z_Area), max(data$z_Area), length.out = 100)

# Hold variability constant (mean of z_Variability)
z_variability_mean <- mean(data$z_Variability)

# Create a data frame for predictions
prediction_data <- data.frame(
  z_Area = z_area_seq,
  z_Variability = z_variability_mean,
  z_Area2 = z_area_seq^2,
  z_Variability2 = z_variability_mean^2,
  z_Area.z_Variability = z_area_seq * z_variability_mean
)

# Predict F1 scores using the model
predicted_f1 <- predict(model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "response")

# Inverse z-transform area for the x-axis
original_area <- z_area_seq * sd_area + mean_area

prediction_plot_data <- data.frame(
  original_area = original_area,
  predicted_f1 = predicted_f1
)

# Plot data points and predicted values
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = ConvexHullArea, y = Adjusted_F1)) +  # Replace 'Area' with the original area column
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "blue", size = 2) +  # Data points
  geom_line(data = prediction_plot_data, aes(x = original_area, y = predicted_f1), color = "red", size = 1) +  # Predicted line
  labs(
    x = "Area (original scale)",
    y = "F1 Score",
    title = "F1 Score as a Function of Area",
    subtitle = "Variability held constant at mean"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

data$z_Variability <- scale(data$variability)

data$z_Variability2 <- data$z_Variability^2

  Adjusted_F1 ~ z_Area + z_Variability + z_Area:z_Variability + z_Area2 +

)

# Model Summary

# 1. Load necessary libraries
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(crayon)
library(merTools)
library(boot)
library(splines)
library(stringr)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)
```
# 2. Vowels sapce Area

# 2.1. Formant
```{r}
df_no_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_no_ADS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))

# occurance column
df_no_ADS <- df_no_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())             

df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_no_IDS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_no_IDS <- df_no_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number()) 

df_da_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_da_ADS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_ADS <- df_da_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())

df_da_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Area", "formant_da_IDS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_IDS <- df_da_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())   

# Calculate summary statistics for each session_id
#session_stats <- df_no_ADS %>%
  #group_by(session_id) %>%
  #summarise(
    #mean_value = mean(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,  # mean 
    #sd_value = sd(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,       # Standard deviation
    #max_value = max(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,     # Maximum value
    #min_value = min(ConvexHullArea, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,     # Minimum value
    #num_observations = n(),                              # Number of observations
    #num_unique_spk_id = n_distinct(spkid)                # Number of unique speaker IDs
  #)

# View the result
#print(session_stats)


output.2.1 <- lmer.full.reduced.null.compare(ConvexHullArea ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth + session_id + (1+Register|spkid) , 
                        optimizer = "nloptwrap", 
                         maxfun = 100000,
                        fullm = TRUE,
                         redm = FALSE, 
                         redmformula = NULL, #ConvexHullArea ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1|spkid), 
                         nullm = FALSE, 
                         nullmformula = variability ~  AgeMonth + (1+Register|spkid) ,
                        data_list = list(df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS, df_da_ADS, df_da_IDS),
                        marginal_means = TRUE,
                        specs = ~Register*Language
                        )

# Define custom contrasts based interaction levels
custom_contrasts <- list(
  "ADS*no vs IDS*no" = c(0, 0, 1, -1),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'IDS no'
  "ADS*da vs IDS*da" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS da' vs 'IDS da'
  "ADS*no vs ADS*da" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'ADS da'
  "IDS*no vs IDS*da" = c(0, -1, 0, 1)     # Comparing 'IDS no' vs 'IDS da'
)
contrast_results.2.1 <- compute_contrasts(output.2.1$emmeans, compute_pairwise = FALSE, custom_contrasts = custom_contrasts, adjust_method = "sidak")
```


```{r}
# Prepare the plot data (aggregating the actual data)
plot.data <- output.2.1$fit_data %>%
  group_by(Language, Register, spkid) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(ConvexHullArea), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
# Extract numeric part of spk_id
plot.data[plot.data$Language == 'no', ]$spkid <- str_extract(plot.data[plot.data$Language == 'no', ]$spkid, "[0-9]+")

three_vowels_formant_vowel_space_area <- lmer.plot.emmeans.contrasts(emmeans.data = output.2.1$emmeans, 
                       contrasts.data = contrast_results.2.1$contrasts, 
                       raw_data = plot.data, 
                       y.ax.transformation = TRUE,
                       inv_y_transform_fun = function(x) { exp(x) - 1 }, 
                       div = 1000,
                       x_labs = 'Groups (Register*Language)',
                       y_labs = "Vowel Space Area (kHz^2)",
                       y_lim = c(0, 600),
                      scale_size_range = c(1, 5),
                      color_gradient_low = "grey60",   
                      color_gradient_high = "grey10",  
                      color_breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),             
                      size_breaks = seq(min(range(plot.data$n)),  max(range(plot.data$n)), by = 1),              
                      y_breaks = seq(0,400, by = 100),
                      size_scaling = NULL,
                      aspect_ratio = NULL,
                      title = NULL,
                      legend = FALSE )

```

  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())             

df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Variability", "mfcc_no_IDS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_no_IDS <- df_no_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number()) 

df_da_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Variability", "mfcc_da_ADS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_ADS <- df_da_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())

df_da_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Variability", "mfcc_da_IDS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
# occurance column
df_da_IDS <- df_da_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())   


output.3.2 <- lmer.full.reduced.null.compare(variability ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth + session_id + (1+Register|spkid) + (1+Register|IPA) , 
                        optimizer = "nloptwrap", 
                         maxfun = 100000,
                        fullm = TRUE,
                         redm = FALSE, 
                         redmformula = NULL, #ConvexHullArea ~ Register + AgeMonth + (1|spkid), 
                         nullm = FALSE, 
                         nullmformula = NULL,
                        data_list = list(df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS, df_da_ADS, df_da_IDS),
                        marginal_means = TRUE,
                        specs = ~Register*Language
                        )

# Define custom contrasts based interaction levels
custom_contrasts <- list(
  "ADS*no vs IDS*no" = c(0, 0, 1, -1),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'IDS no'
  "ADS*da vs IDS*da" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS da' vs 'IDS da'
  "ADS*no vs ADS*da" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'ADS da'
  "IDS*no vs IDS*da" = c(0, -1, 0, 1)     # Comparing 'IDS no' vs 'IDS da'
)
contrast_results.3.2 <- compute_contrasts(output.3.2$emmeans, compute_pairwise = FALSE, custom_contrasts = custom_contrasts, adjust_method = "sidak")

```{r}
df_no_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Generalisability", "CNN","mfcc_no_ADS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
df_no_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Generalisability", "CNN", "mfcc_no_IDS_3_bordervowels_M.xlsx"))
df_no_ADS$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df_no_ADS$F1_Score)
df_no_IDS$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df_no_IDS$F1_Score)
df_da_ADS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Generalisability", "CNN","mfcc_da_ADS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
df_da_IDS <- read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "VowelBasedMeasures", "Generalisability", "CNN", "mfcc_da_IDS_3_bordervowels.xlsx"))
df_da_ADS$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df_da_ADS$F1_Score)
df_da_IDS$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df_da_IDS$F1_Score)



# occurance column
df_no_ADS <- df_no_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())             


# occurance column
df_no_IDS <- df_no_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number()) 


# occurance column
df_da_ADS <- df_da_ADS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number())

# occurance column
df_da_IDS <- df_da_IDS %>%
  arrange(spkid, AgeMonth) %>%                  
  group_by(spkid, Register) %>%                 
  mutate(session_id = row_number()) 



output.6.2 <- glmmTB.full.reduced.null.compare(fullmformula = F1_Score ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth + train_samples +  (1+Register|spkid),
                                           family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
                                           zi_formula = ~0,
                                             fullm = TRUE,
                                             redm = FALSE, 
                                             redmformula = F1_Score ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth + session_id + train_samples + (1|spkid), 
                                             nullm = TRUE, 
                                             nullmformula = F1_Score ~ Register*Language + AgeMonth +  (1+Register|spkid),
                                             data_list = list(df_no_ADS, df_no_IDS, df_da_ADS, df_da_IDS), 
                                           marginal_means = TRUE,
                                          specs = ~Register*Language
                                          )

# Define custom contrasts based interaction levels
custom_contrasts <- list(
  "ADS*no vs IDS*no" = c(0, 0, 1, -1),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'IDS no'
  "ADS*da vs IDS*da" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS da' vs 'IDS da'
  "ADS*no vs ADS*da" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0),    # Comparing 'ADS no' vs 'ADS da'
  "IDS*no vs IDS*da" = c(0, -1, 0, 1)     # Comparing 'IDS no' vs 'IDS da'
)
contrast_results.6.2 <- compute_contrasts(output.6.2$emmeans, compute_pairwise = FALSE, custom_contrasts = custom_contrasts, adjust_method = "sidak")
```

```{r}
library(betareg)
library(MASS)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(betareg)


# Standardize predictors
#data$z_Area <- scale(data$ConvexHullArea)
#data$z_Variability <- scale(data$variability)

# Adjust F1 Score if it contains 0 or 1
#data$Adjusted_F1 <- (data$F1_Score * (nrow(data) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(data)

```

```{r}
data = read_excel(file.path(getwd(), "CombinedMeasures", "formant_XGBoost_3_corner_vowels.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
# Fit beta, norm, gamma distribution
fitbeta <- fitdist(data$F1_Score, "beta", method = "mle")
fitnorm <- fitdist(data$F1_Score, "norm", method = "mle")
fitgamma <- fitdist(data$F1_Score, "gamma", method = "mle")

# Summary of fit
summary(fitbeta)
summary(fitnorm)
summary(fitgamma)

# Plot fitted distribution
#plot(fit)


```

```{r}
# Fit Beta Regression Model
# Load the package


# Standardize predictors
data$z_Area <- scale(data$ConvexHullArea)
data$z_Variability <- scale(data$variability)

# Add Polynomial Terms
data$z_Area2 <- data$z_Area^2
data$z_Variability2 <- data$z_Variability^2

# Adjust F1 Score if it contains 0 or 1
data$Adjusted_F1 <- (data$F1_Score * (nrow(data) - 1) + 0.5) / nrow(data)

# Fit Beta Regression Model with Polynomial Terms
model <- betareg(
  Adjusted_F1 ~ z_Area + z_Variability + z_Area:z_Variability + z_Area2 + 
    z_Variability2,
  data = data
)

# Model Summary
summary(model)



```

```{r}
# Define constants and functions for inverse z-transformation
mean_area <- mean(data$ConvexHullArea)  # Replace 'Area' with the original area column name
sd_area <- sd(data$ConvexHullArea)

# Define a sequence for z_Area (varying z-transformed area)
z_area_seq <- seq(min(data$z_Area), max(data$z_Area), length.out = 100)

# Hold variability constant (mean of z_Variability)
z_variability_mean <- mean(data$z_Variability)

# Create a data frame for predictions
prediction_data <- data.frame(
  z_Area = z_area_seq,
  z_Variability = z_variability_mean,
  z_Area2 = z_area_seq^2,
  z_Variability2 = z_variability_mean^2,
  z_Area.z_Variability = z_area_seq * z_variability_mean
)

# Predict F1 scores using the model
predicted_f1 <- predict(model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "response")

# Inverse z-transform area for the x-axis
original_area <- z_area_seq * sd_area + mean_area

# Bootstrap confidence intervals
n_bootstrap <- 1000
bootstrap_predictions <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_bootstrap, ncol = length(z_area_seq))

for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
  # Resample data with replacement
  bootstrap_data <- data[sample(1:nrow(data), replace = TRUE), ]
  
  # Fit the model on bootstrap data
  bootstrap_model <- betareg(
    formula = Adjusted_F1 ~ z_Area + z_Variability + z_Area:z_Variability +
      z_Area2 + z_Variability2,
    data = bootstrap_data
  )
  
  # Predict using bootstrap model
  bootstrap_predictions[i, ] <- predict(bootstrap_model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "response")
}

# Calculate confidence intervals
lower_ci <- apply(bootstrap_predictions, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
upper_ci <- apply(bootstrap_predictions, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)

prediction_plot_data <- data.frame(
  original_area = original_area,
  predicted_f1 = predicted_f1,
  lower_ci = lower_ci,
  upper_ci = upper_ci
)

# Plot data points, predicted values, and confidence bands
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)  # For formatting axis labels

# Convert Hz² to kHz²
prediction_plot_data$original_area_khz2 <- prediction_plot_data$original_area / 1e6
data$ConvexHullArea_khz2 <- data$ConvexHullArea / 1e6

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = ConvexHullArea_khz2, y = Adjusted_F1), alpha = 0.5, color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = prediction_plot_data, aes(x = original_area_khz2, y = predicted_f1), color = "red", size = 1) +  
  geom_ribbon(data = prediction_plot_data, aes(x = original_area_khz2, ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), fill = "red", alpha = 0.2) +  
  labs(
    x = "Vowel Space Area (kHz²)",  # Updated label
    y = "F1 Score"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +  # Remove scientific notation, keep two decimals
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p)
```

ggsave(file.path(getwd(), "StatPlots", "XGBoost_Formant_Area_vs_F1_score.jpg"), plot = p, height = 5)

# Create a data frame for predictions
prediction_data <- data.frame(
  z_Area = z_area_seq,
  z_Variability = z_variability_mean,
  z_Area2 = z_area_seq^2,
  z_Variability2 = z_variability_mean^2,
  z_Area.z_Variability = z_area_seq * z_variability_mean
)

# Predict F1 scores using the model
predicted_f1 <- predict(model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "response")

# Inverse z-transform area for the x-axis
original_area <- z_area_seq * sd_area + mean_area

# Bootstrap confidence intervals
n_bootstrap <- 1000
bootstrap_predictions <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_bootstrap, ncol = length(z_area_seq))

for (i in 1:n_bootstrap) {
  # Resample data with replacement
  bootstrap_data <- data[sample(1:nrow(data), replace = TRUE), ]
  
  # Fit the model on bootstrap data
  bootstrap_model <- betareg(
    formula = Adjusted_F1 ~ z_Area + z_Variability + z_Area:z_Variability +
      z_Area2 + z_Variability2,
    data = bootstrap_data
  )
  
  # Predict using bootstrap model
  bootstrap_predictions[i, ] <- predict(bootstrap_model, newdata = prediction_data, type = "response")
}

# Calculate confidence intervals
lower_ci <- apply(bootstrap_predictions, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
upper_ci <- apply(bootstrap_predictions, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)

prediction_plot_data <- data.frame(
  original_area = original_area,
  predicted_f1 = predicted_f1,
  lower_ci = lower_ci,
  upper_ci = upper_ci
)

# Plot data points, predicted values, and confidence bands
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)  # For formatting axis labels

# Convert Hz² to kHz²
prediction_plot_data$original_area_khz2 <- prediction_plot_data$original_area / 1e6
data$ConvexHullArea_khz2 <- data$ConvexHullArea / 1e6

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = ConvexHullArea_khz2, y = Adjusted_F1), alpha = 0.5, color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = prediction_plot_data, aes(x = original_area_khz2, y = predicted_f1), color = "red", size = 1) +  
  geom_ribbon(data = prediction_plot_data, aes(x = original_area_khz2, ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), fill = "red", alpha = 0.2) +  
  labs(
    x = "Vowel Space Area (kHz²)",  # Updated label
    y = "F1 Score"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma_format(accuracy = 0.0001)) +  # Remove scientific notation, keep two decimals
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1)) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p)
